title: Sloth bear cubs ride piggyback

scenes.headline: Mum is the school bus
scenes.body: Sloth bear cubs cling to a shaggy 'saddle' of fur on her back until about 6–9 months old.

scenes.label: top front teeth adults don't have
scenes.body: The gap helps them suck up termites and ants.

scenes.headline: Found only in South Asia
scenes.body: India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan and Bangladesh.

caption:
The only bus route with fur seats.

About 20,000 or fewer sloth bears may remain in the wild, though no reliable large-scale survey has been done.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; Animal Diversity Web. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Cute hook with a real fact underneath, from one wild CC photo shot in an Indian tiger reserve. HIGH-RISK format: cute-animal compilations of third-party clips are unoriginal; only OK with our own footage.
